Audit Methodology: Competitions were imported from CIVLCOMPS and Airtribune with their original IGC track files and scoring parameters, then scored independently using the Aervyx GAP engine. Results are compared against the official published scores from each platform.

Weight Allocation Fix (2026-04-04): Corrected the leading weight allocation from the legacy AirScore value (0.175) to the GAP2023 PG standard (0.26) for events 12–16. Available leading points now match FS reference values (e.g., task 53: Aervyx 165.3 vs FS 157.1).

Known Issues Affecting Comparison:
  • Start cylinder detection failures: Many tasks show started_at=None for most pilots despite reaching ESS/goal. This causes fastest_time_seconds to be stored as Unix epochs (>1 billion) or near-zero, breaking speed and leading point calculations. Affected tasks show quality < 1.0 or inflated fastest times.
  • Missing track data: Some tasks have very few pilots with uploaded/processed tracks (e.g., US Open Task 1: 7 of 126 pilots).
  • Leading coefficient: The leading coefficient distribution algorithm differs between FS and Aervyx, causing systematic per-pilot leading point differences even when available points match.
  • Route distance: Aervyx computes ~0.4 km shorter distances consistently (likely different geodesic calculation), causing small distance point differences.
  • Speed scoring: Per-pilot speed point differences of 5–35 pts on healthy tasks, likely from different SSS/ESS crossing time interpolation.
  • Adjusted Diff removes leading points from both sides to isolate distance+speed accuracy.
